Metadata.title: Roberta Matera | Full-Stack Developer · Frontend & UX/UI Design · Bern
Metadata.description: Full-stack developer focused on frontend and UX/UI design, with a master’s degree in architecture. Angular, React, TypeScript, Java and Spring Boot. Based in Bern.

Hero.title: Full-stack developer focused on frontend and design, shaped by architecture.
Hero.intro: I’m Roberta, a full-stack developer with 4.5 years of experience in banking, insurance, retail and healthcare. I specialise in frontend and UX/UI design, and I bring an architect’s way of thinking to every interface: structure first, details always, people at the centre.
